About Niveza India Pvt Ltd.

Established September 2012

Niveza India Pvt. Ltd. is a SEBI registered research, advisory, and financial technology firm. We have proven experience in providing one of the best performing stock picks backed by best-in-industry service and by money back guarantee. Our m360 (multibagger 360) stock picks product is based on value investing and long term investing principles followed by Warren Buffett and Rakesh Jhujhunwala. We also provide shorter duration version of multibagger product i.e. v360 stock picks which allows you to consistently grow your capital by exiting positions in 3-6 months when they get fairly valued and re-investing in other undervalued stocks.
